nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.sync_measurements¶

Sync PESA-Fat stage-3 measurement workbooks into the NVITK database.

Reads per-subject Excel files produced by CT-PET v5 and Dixon v5 stage 3, upserts long-form rows into image_measurements, and rebuilds the SQLite catalog index once at the end.

Use --from-source local for workstation result roots (layout_local) or --from-source sge to SFTP files from cluster storage (layout_cluster) into the local mirror before publishing.
